note: Run Cloud is operated by Small Scale Labs AB, a private company registered at Agavägen 19, 181 55, Lidingo, Sweden (per its Privacy Policy). The product has pivoted: its original Linux microVM sandbox offering (Firecracker-based, the subject of this pricing card) is deprecated and closed to new organizations as of 2026-09-28; the current live product is iOS simulators / Android emulators / Xcode builds in the browser. No press coverage, funding announcement, accelerator listing, Crunchbase/PitchBook profile, LinkedIn company page, or about/team/careers page could be located within the research window — web searches (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Marginalia, HN Algolia, Swedish business registries) were either blocked/rate-limited or returned no relevant results.
